packageRules.description: Do not take a version published in the last 3 days: most poisoned releases are found and pulled within hours
The Maven wrapper (with its distribution checksum) and the npm tools pinned in Makefile, ci.yml and pre-commit move as one
Spring Boot and the libraries whose versions it manages move together
Spring Modulith is versioned separately but must match the Boot line
Security fixes are not held back by the weekly schedule
Test and tooling containers (compose and Testcontainers images)
A pre-release is never proposed for the main branch except for the planned Boot upgrade
